root_cause.text: The mtk_eth_soc driver freed its dsa_meta metadata_dst objects in mtk_free_dev() with metadata_dst_free()/kfree() even though RX skbs held non-refcounted RCU-protected dst pointers via skb_dst_set_noref(), causing the dst memory to be reclaimed before RCU readers finished.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `metadata_dst_free(eth->dsa_meta[i]);` to `dst_release(&eth->dsa_meta[i]->dst);`, and the commit/CVE explicitly state that `metadata_dst_free()` “frees the metadata_dst with kfree() immediately, bypassing the RCU grace period,” while `skb_dst_set_noref()` installs a “non-refcounted pointer” that “must remain valid until all RCU readers complete.”

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The mtk_eth_soc driver freed its dsa_meta metadata_dst objects in mtk_free_dev() with metadata_dst_free()/kfree() even though RX skbs held non-refcounted RCU-protected dst pointers via skb_dst_set_noref(), causing the dst memory to be reclaimed before RCU readers finished.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `metadata_dst_free(eth->dsa_meta[i]);` to `dst_release(&eth->dsa_meta[i]->dst);`, and the commit/CVE explicitly state that `metadata_dst_free()` “frees the metadata_dst with kfree() immediately, bypassing the RCU grace period,” while `skb_dst_set_noref()` installs a “non-refcounted pointer” that “must remain valid until all RCU readers complete.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Use dst_release() instead of direct metadata_dst_free() when cleaning up dsa_meta entries so metadata dst objects are released through proper reference counting.
intent_record.what: In mtk_free_dev(), the cleanup loop over eth->dsa_meta entries replaces the call to metadata_dst_free(eth->dsa_meta[i]) with a call to dst_release(&eth->dsa_meta[i]->dst).
intent_record.how: At runtime, freeing each dsa_meta entry now goes through the dst reference-counted release path instead of directly freeing the metadata_dst object, ensuring the object is only deallocated when its dst reference count reaches zero and preventing incorrect direct destruction.

grouping_result.intent: Use dst_release() instead of direct metadata_dst_free() when cleaning up dsa_meta entries so metadata dst objects are released through proper reference counting.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by replacing direct freeing of metadata_dst objects with dst_release(), ensuring proper dst lifetime/refcount handling for RCU-protected skb dst pointers.

candidates.rationale: This directly frees metadata_dst objects during device cleanup, bypassing dst reference-counted/RCU-safe release semantics even though RX skbs may still hold noref dst pointers to these objects via skb_dst_set_noref(), leading to premature reclamation and UAF.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement directly frees the metadata_dst object during cleanup, bypassing the dst release path required for objects still reachable through skb_dst_set_noref() RCU-protected dst pointers on RX skbs. That premature free is the root cause of the use-after-free vulnerability.
